# HarfBuzz complex text shaping assets

`maplibre-gl-complex-text.js` is vendored from `wipfli/maplibre-gl-complex-text` at commit `45c5aa1920093d39324640a417b3c4ebd530bc6d` and is distributed under `LICENSE-MIT.txt`. The vendored plugin identifies its copied HarfBuzzJS files (`hbjs.js` and `hb.wasm`) as Apache-2.0; the full Apache notice is retained. The checked HarfBuzzJS source at commit `3f162fa2c6ba68b40839fe2c11502a26632e20df` includes an MIT license, also retained for attribution clarity. Noto multiscript shaping fonts are under SIL OFL. The `pgf-encoding` mappings are MIT (source commit `d89d7154ef4c0d7c5d1628d69ae0abab01beede0`). All full notices are retained in this directory. The plugin uses the Mapbox RTL plugin API.

The file SHA-256 is `aca114493690c981ea936d1168338a4b53564c2b4377825f3522aca0594e7c19`.
